main_body: autumn tree with orange-red foliage canopy and vertical brown trunk
top_band: upper lit crown of the canopy (bright orange-red tones, rows 1-11) sitting above the darker underside and lower foliage clumps (rows 12-27) and trunk (rows 28-44)
evidence: The tree canopy has a rounded 3/4 volume with a top-lit upper crown (rows 1-11) and shaded lower foliage puffs/underside (rows 12-27) overhanging the vertical trunk below (rows 28-44).

style.evidence: While the canopy has 5 orange-red ramp steps and some speckle texture, it consists of 4 large rounded blob shapes rather than the intricate, distinct leaf-clump clusters of the Beodeul reference trees. More importantly, the trunk (rows 28-44) is a rigid, straight vertical post with a dark near-black outline, repetitive diagonal stripes, and a flat horizontal base bar, lacking the organic flared roots, bark grain, and peeking inner branches seen in both reference trees.
